items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: some of the stuff he did with Pharoah Sanders in the 60s

ctx.x: Yes he is and he’s still teaching. And he said the same thing. Because I was asking him how does the music of jazz musicians in the 40s compare to some of the stuff he did with Pharoah Sanders in the 60s. Was it less spiritual in the 40s and more just entertainment.
I’m interested, what did he say?
